tables.caption: campi
rows:
Before filling out this form, determine if the purchase is capital equipment or capitalized software. Verify that the:
  • Equipment or software has a normal life expectancy of more than one year, and is not expendable. Non-expendable means that the equipment is not consumed by it’s use.
  • Capitalized cost will exceed [importo]. The [importo] value includes the price of the equipment and other costs needed to put the equipment into service such as required installation services, startup components, accessories, startup kits (e.g. regents), freight, handling and sales tax.
  • Determine if a trade-in will be involved
    • If a trade-in is part of the purchase, the Department Asset Custodian must approve the release of the trade-in before the requisition is submitted.
    • Establish the price for trade-in and arrangements for the supplier to receive or pick up the product.

Contact Capital Accounting if you have questions determining if your purchase is a capitalized asset or regarding Asset Management codes. · UserDefinedFieldParamHTML=Please see the "Capital Equipment How To Guide" for guidance on completing this form.

1. Use this form to request:
  • Capital Equipment - Equipment costing [importo] or more and has a life expectancy of more than one year

For equipment and software orders under [importo], please use the Non-Catalog or Amount-based PO Forms

2. Fill out all required fields shown in bold text. Please note all fields may be necessary to complete the transaction.

3. Provide as much information as possible for any related equipment services.

4. Attach any relevant supporting documents (i.e. vendor quote, technical specifications, warranty information, service level agreements, software licenses, etc.)

5. If any attached documents are for both external and internal viewing, attach it ONLY in the External Attachments section.

6. To order more than one piece of equipment, fill out the form and then click "Add to Cart".

You have now completed this form.

To order more than one piece of equipment:
  • Select "Add to Cart" from the Available Actions dropdown.
  • Update the form and add the form again to the cart.
After adding all forms to the cart, indicate whether your equipment/software is taxable.
  • If the equipment is taxable, check the Taxable checkbox for each line.
  • If the equipment is not taxable, do not check the Taxable checkbox for each line.
Be sure to specify asset management codes, especially the Custody Code.
  • From the "Proceed to Checkout" page, click the Asset Management tab.
  • Input the Custody Code and Asset Location.
  • Input the Tag Number ONLY if the purchase is adding to the value of an existing piece of equipment.
